title: audit detail request.write
description: detail of audit rows with action request.write: a successful write request left no audit row of its own; written by the request pipeline (ADR-063 section 1). For the routes of agent_hub.audit.generic_routes (WebAuthn begin ceremonies, idempotent replays) it is their audit; for any other route it marks a defect. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
